description.value: Mountainaire is a family-oriented 40-acre campground and RV park set in Vancouver Island wilderness between Ladysmith and Nanaimo, offering tenting, full/partial-service RV sites, glamping units, and cabins. It sits about 5 km from the Trans-Canada Highway and roughly 20 minutes from both Nanaimo ferry terminals (Duke Point and Departure Bay), making it a natural start or end point for island touring routes. A short rainforest trail leads to the Nanaimo River's Crystal Bowl swimming hole, and the park hosts a convenience store, arcade, and regular family events.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at mountainairervpark.com is fully live and content-rich, confirming a real, operating 40-acre campground at 1092 Spruston Road, Nanaimo, BC. Showers, washrooms, laundry, and an on-site convenience store are explicitly named on the front page and amenities subpage; reservations are confirmed via the 'Book Now' system referenced throughout. No OSM tags were available, so all field values derive entirely from website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, publicly bookable campground with tenting options on a key Vancouver Island touring route; website is current and detailed.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM record has no tags, phone, or address; all contact details sourced solely from the website. contact_confirmed.phone and contact_confirmed.address are null because OSM provided no values to corroborate.
